name: Telegram
tagline: Cloud messenger and channel platform with crypto-powered mini-app economy
facts: Pavel Durov; French probe, Russian warrant Jul 2026

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Fast, secure, free messaging that no government or advertiser controls.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: An open super-app: chats, channels, bots, mini apps and a TON-based wallet in one platform.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Free core for all; monetise power users (Premium), channel ads, Stars purchases and TON ecosystem deals.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Cloud sync across devices, 200K-member groups, unlimited channels, open bot and mini-app APIs, neutrality brand.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Crypto and mini-apps economy on TON plus AI partnerships (announced xAI Grok deal, unconfirmed by Musk).

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Is a business relying on Toncoin deals and a founder facing two criminal cases investable or IPO-ready?

customers.pain: Want fast sync, big files, no phone-number exposure
customers.why: Cloud sync, usernames, 2–4GB files, rich features, no ads in private chats

customers.pain: Need direct reach to millions without algorithmic suppression
customers.why: Unlimited subscribers, 50% ad revenue share, paid posts and Stars

customers.pain: Need distribution and payments without app store gatekeepers
customers.why: Free Bot API, mini apps reach 1B users, Stars and TON payments

customers.who: Brands, crypto projects, apps buying Telegram Ads
customers.pain: Need to reach niche, hard-to-target communities
customers.why: Context-targeted sponsored messages in large public channels

customers.who: Users in Iran, Russia, Ukraine, Middle East
customers.why: Channels as news source; resistance to government takedown

CPM sponsored messages; 50% shared with channel owners

~$300M of H1'25 revenue from exclusivity agreements

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: H1'25 $870M: roughly one-third TON-linked exclusivity deals, rest Premium, ads and Stars; FY25 target $2B, unaudited.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: 1B+ users, ~15M Premium payers (~1.5%); advertisers and crypto partners fill the gap.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: ~30 core engineers and lean ops; profits swing with Toncoin price, causing H1'25 write-down loss.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Premium conversion, ad fill in channels, mini-app commerce, AI partnerships, eventual IPO.

bullets.label: Lesson
bullets.text: Tying revenue to a volatile token boosts topline but makes earnings and governance hard to underwrite.

friction: Default chats are not end-to-end encrypted
Scams, crypto spam and illicit content in public channels
Feature overload overwhelms new and casual users
Government throttling and blocks disrupt access
Founder legal risk shakes trust and partners

competitors.label: Messaging

competitors.label: Broadcast
competitors.text: WhatsApp Channels, X, YouTube, Discord, Substack

competitors.label: Mini apps
competitors.text: WeChat, LINE, Kakao super-apps; app stores

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Open APIs, huge groups, cloud sync, neutrality brand, crypto-native economy

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Durov legal cases, Russian throttling, Toncoin volatility, content-moderation regulation
